title: A Prospective Total Joint Surgery Registry to Monitor Short- and Long-Term Clinical Outcomes
official: A Prospective Total Joint Surgery Registry to Monitor Short- and Long-Term Clinical Outcomes
summary: The investigators propose a prospective longitudinal registry study to collect and compare preoperative and postoperative information from patients who undergo total joint arthroplasty (TJA). Outcomes will be assessed with common, routinely available patient-reported outcomes measures (PROM's) such as the HOOS Jr., Oxford score, Knee Society Score, Harris Hip Score, and other patient satisfaction and function assessments in use in Orthopedics.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who are scheduled to undergo TJA by the Principal Investigator

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18
* Unable to speak and read English
* Prisoners or any other patients who, in the opinion of the investigator, are unlikely to return for follow-ups or unreliable in completing the assessments
